review_findings.title: Pin checkout and artifact identity to PR source SHA
review_findings.details: On pull_request events actions/checkout defaults to a synthetic merge ref, so git rev-parse HEAD and github.sha may not identify the PR head requested for local acceptance. Use github.event.pull_request.head.sha when available for checkout, manifest sourceCommit, and artifact naming; retain github.sha fallback for workflow_dispatch.
